caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a standing male figure on a rectangular pedestal against a plain tan or light brown background. The figure is barefoot and dressed in garments that appear to be made of animal hide, covering his body from the waist down and across the chest. He has long, straight hair that reaches past his shoulders and wears a shoulder strap with a circular ornament at the center of his chest. An outer garment, possibly a cloak or cape, drapes over his left shoulder and down his back and side, rendered with bluish-gray tones. The statue’s right arm is partially missing or appears damaged at the elbow. The color palette consists of earthy browns, muted blues, and grays for the figure, with the backdrop in solid tan. The drawing is bordered with multiple lines, including soft green and cream shades, framing the central image.
title: Cigar Store Indian
